title: Integrals over finite sets with respect to H⁰ = μHE[0]
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, let F be a finite subset of ℝ^P (a Finset), let f : ℝ^P → ℝ be any function and g : ℝ^P → [0, ∞] any function (no measurability is assumed). Then the Bochner integral of f over F with respect to Mathlib's normalized 0-dimensional Hausdorff measure H⁰ = μHE[0] equals Σ_{x∈F} f(x). Likewise the lower Lebesgue integral of g over F with respect to μHE[0] equals Σ_{x∈F} g(x).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (F : Finset (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (g : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞), (∫ x in (F : Set (Euclid P)), f x ∂μHE[0]) = ∑ x ∈ F, f x ∧ (∫⁻ x in (F : Set (Euclid P)), g x ∂μHE[0]) = ∑ x ∈ F, g x
